title: Blame!
author: Tsutomu Nihei
review: Pure environmental storytelling. Nihei's megastructures are imposing and strong. Brought to this work by Dami Lee who talks about architecture on YT. I enjoy having to fill in the gaps in the story since it leaves more up to mystery about how the world functions.

title: Vinland Saga
author: Makoto Yukimura
review: A masterpiece regarding the philosophy of violence. Watched the anime first while in Japan and then bought the compendium volume.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
review: The foundation of modern sci-fi. Herbert's world-building and ecological focus remain unmatched.
